description: This Java class defines a RestClient that performs HTTP operations (CRUD and pagination) on a 'Person' resource via REST API calls. It uses Spring's RestTemplate and custom utilities for authentication.

classes.name: RestClient
classes.description: A utility class for performing REST operations related to 'Person' resources, including creating, reading, updating, deleting, and pagination testing.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point executing CRUD operations and pagination tests.

methods.name: createPerson
methods.description: Creates a new Person resource via POST request.

methods.name: readPerson
methods.description: Retrieves a Person resource via GET request.

methods.name: updatePerson
methods.description: Updates an existing Person resource via PUT request.

methods.name: deletePerson
methods.description: Deletes a Person resource via DELETE request.

methods.name: createPersonWithAssignedId
methods.description: Creates a Person resource with a specific ID via POST request.

methods.name: getFirstPageWithTenElements
methods.description: Retrieves the first page containing 10 Person entries, testing pagination.

methods.name: getFirstPageWithFifteenElements
methods.description: Retrieves the first page containing 15 Person entries, testing pagination.
